report:
EXAMINATION: MRI Brain
INDICATION: Headache and visual changes

FINDINGS:
enhancing mass lesion identified, measuring 3.2 cm³ located in the Left Frontal Lobe occupying approximately 53.1% of the Left Frontal Lobe.
The tumor core measures 4.2 cm³.
Associated peritumoral edema (7.3 cm³) is present.
Predominantly left-sided distribution.
No significant midline shift is observed.

IMPRESSION:
Brain mass with enhancement and peritumoral edema, most consistent with high-grade glioma. Further evaluation with tissue sampling is recommended.
